"Baulettami" isn't just a dog grooming salon; it's a fragrant, clean, and welcoming corner of paradise where our furry friends are pampered and, of course, groomed with care and so much love.
Ylenia welcomed our lively cocker spaniel Molly with all her heart, caring for her every step of the way, from a difficult initial deep clean to subsequent equally thorough cleans, never losing patience. Throughout, she maintained impeccable professionalism and a calmness that she transmitted to Molly, moment after moment, hour after hour. Every time we pick her up, Molly doesn't appear tired or nervous at all; she's super calm and happy. For her part, Ylenia welcomes you, even after all the exhaustion, with the same smile with which she welcomed the dog hours before. I highly recommend this wonderful place, and of course, first and foremost Ylenia, its owner.
